surface.name: Jamba Chat Completions REST API
surface.selection_basis: AI21 documents public REST access and a Jamba chat-completions endpoint, so a direct HTTP request is the least dependency-heavy first-response route.

alternatives_considered.name: AI21 Python SDK
alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: The SDK is optional convenience over the public REST API.

alternatives_considered.name: Cloud platform deployment
alternatives_considered.reason_not_primary: Cloud marketplaces introduce different account, IAM, and deployment boundaries.

entry_point.developer_intent: Create an AI21 Studio API key and receive a Jamba chat completion.
assumed_prior_state: No AI21 Studio API key exists.
A browser and cURL are available.

documented_first_success.normalized_outcome: An authenticated AI21 Studio chat-completions request returns a Jamba assistant message.
documented_first_success.observable_completion_signal: The response contains generated assistant content.

boundary_evidence.official_label_or_terminal_state: The API reference documents POST /studio/v1/chat/completions with request and response examples.

documented_first_success.why_this_is_the_boundary: The first returned Jamba message completes the basic language-model API job before private deployment, RAG, or agent workflows.

prerequisites.requirement: An AI21 Studio API key exported as AI21_API_KEY.
An HTTPS client such as cURL.

primary_path.action: Create or sign in to an AI21 Studio account.
primary_path.success_signal: The API key area is reachable.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Signup fields are outside the API reference.

primary_path.action: Create an API key and export it as AI21_API_KEY.
primary_path.success_signal: The key is available to the HTTP client.

primary_path.action: POST messages and a current Jamba model to the Studio chat-completions endpoint.
details: Use the Bearer API key and JSON content type.
primary_path.success_signal: The API returns an assistant message.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: Credential, access, model, or request errors prevent output.

primary_path.action: Confirm that the response contains generated assistant content.
primary_path.failure_or_wait: An error response is not first success.

friction_gates.description: An AI21 API key is required.

sources.title: AI21 Developer Platform overview
evidence_supported: Public REST API and SDK access

sources.title: Jamba API reference
evidence_supported: Endpoint, request, authentication, and response boundary

uncertainties.question: What payment or trial-credit state is required for a newly created Studio account?
uncertainties.impact: Could add a mandatory billing gate.
uncertainties.reason_unresolved: The selected setup and API pages do not establish a universal new-account balance.
